data.description:
## Context / Problem

`docs/ticket-model.md:12` states that five ticket types and statuses exist, while `src/rebar/types.py:21` defines seven of each. The relationship prose is already current; the drift is limited to the type/status taxonomy.

## Approach

Generate a marked taxonomy section in `docs/ticket-model.md` from the canonical ticket type/status definitions and add a drift check. Preserve hand-maintained relationship documentation outside the generated section.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/types.py`
- `docs/ticket-model.md`
- a focused taxonomy generator/check and its tests

## Testing

Cover all live types and statuses, a deliberate source-vocabulary addition, and a deliberately stale generated block.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The documented ticket type and status vocabularies are generated from the canonical schema/definitions.
- [ ] The generated block includes all seven current types and statuses and leaves current relationship prose untouched.
- [ ] A source vocabulary change without documentation regeneration fails the drift check.
- [ ] The generator is deterministic and its focused tests pass.
data.title: Generate ticket taxonomy documentation from the canonical schema
